mapper.insert: insert into odetails (order_status, product_no, order_no) values (0, #{product_no}, #{order_no});
mapper.select: SELECT orders.order_no, product.product_no, COUNT(*) AS same_product_count FROM orders INNER JOIN odetails ON orders.order_no = odetails.order_no INNER JOIN product ON product.product_no = odetails.product_no INNER JOIN pcategory ON product.pcategory_no = pcategory.pcategory_no WHERE orders.uno = #{loginUno} GROUP BY orders.order_no, product.product_no ORDER BY orders.order_no DESC;
